candidates.name: GetEffectiveRightsFromAclW
verified_facts: Calculates effective rights granted to a trustee by an ACL
Trustee group membership contributes to the result
semantic_limits: The function has documented limitations with inherited deny ACEs and does not replace full Authz evaluation.

candidates.name: AccessChk
verified_facts: Displays effective access for files, services, processes, registry keys, and kernel objects
Supports account-scoped and object-type diagnostics
semantic_limits: Tool output must be versioned, bounded, and correlated; it does not prove task execution or receipt publication.

candidates.name: OpenProcess
verified_facts: Opens a process handle with requested access rights
Some access requires SeDebugPrivilege
semantic_limits: Opening a PID without start-time and image correlation is unsafe because PIDs can be reused.

candidates.name: Process Security and Access Rights
verified_facts: Defines process-object access rights including query-limited and query-information rights
Process operations are security-checked
semantic_limits: Possessing a process right does not prove the process is the canonical runner or safe to mutate.

candidates.name: QueryFullProcessImageNameW
verified_facts: Retrieves the full executable image path for a process handle
Supports Win32 or native path formatting
semantic_limits: Image-path equality still requires file identity, hash, signature, PID, and start-time correlation.

candidates.name: GetProcessMitigationPolicy
verified_facts: Retrieves a selected mitigation policy for a process
ProcessSignaturePolicy is among the supported policy classes
semantic_limits: Mitigation settings describe hardening state and do not authenticate the executable or receipts.

candidates.name: PROCESS_MITIGATION_POLICY
verified_facts: Enumerates mitigation policy classes including signature and image-load policies
The selected class determines the output structure
semantic_limits: A policy class identifier alone does not prove the returned structure is complete or current.

candidates.name: PROCESS_MITIGATION_BINARY_SIGNATURE_POLICY
verified_facts: Describes process restrictions and audit flags for image signatures
Flags distinguish Microsoft-signed, Store-signed, and opt-in behavior
semantic_limits: A disabled restriction does not mean loaded binaries are untrusted; each image still requires verification.

candidates.name: GetProcessInformation
verified_facts: Retrieves information selected by a process-information class
Requires an appropriately authorized process handle
semantic_limits: The supported classes and access rights vary; returned data does not establish canonical ownership.

candidates.name: WinVerifyTrust
verified_facts: Performs a trust-verification action on a specified object
Can verify portable executable images through a trust provider
semantic_limits: Trust results depend on policy, state action, revocation settings, and exact input object.

candidates.name: WINTRUST_DATA
verified_facts: Supplies UI, revocation, union-choice, state, and provider flags to WinVerifyTrust
Verification behavior is controlled by these fields
semantic_limits: Omitted or permissive flags can produce a result that is unsuitable for recovery authorization.

candidates.name: CryptCATAdminAcquireContext2
verified_facts: Acquires a catalog-administrator context with a selected hash algorithm
The context is used by catalog lookup functions
semantic_limits: Context creation does not prove a file is catalog-signed or trusted.

candidates.name: CryptCATAdminCalcHashFromFileHandle2
verified_facts: Calculates a catalog-member hash from an open file handle using the selected algorithm
Supports a two-call buffer sizing pattern
semantic_limits: A catalog hash is not a general content hash and must be tied to the exact open file identity.

candidates.name: CryptCATAdminEnumCatalogFromHash
verified_facts: Enumerates catalogs containing a specified member hash
Enumeration continues using the previous catalog context
semantic_limits: Catalog membership does not itself prove trust policy success, freshness, or expected publisher.

candidates.name: CryptCATCatalogInfoFromContext
verified_facts: Retrieves catalog information from a catalog context
The catalog path can be read back for subsequent verification
semantic_limits: A catalog path must be canonicalized and verified; existence alone does not prove trust.
